shortcut_name: Trace condition collapses to finding an interference triangle
evidence: deepseek-v4-flash searches for "w in adj[v]" after selecting two neighbors; gpt-oss-120b builds adjacency bitsets and neighbor lists; glm-5 reasons through the "8 possible cases" of the three off-diagonal entries
affordance_in_statement: The matrix has Z_{i,i}=1, Z_{i,j}=0 for an interference link, and Z_{i,j}=1 otherwise, and the required stability characteristic is "the trace of the matrix Z^5 ... exactly 3."
removal_suggestion: There is no wording-only removal that preserves the stated mathematics: with the given diagonal and binary symmetric off-diagonal entries, trace(Z^5)=3 is equivalent to all three selected pairs being interference links. To defeat this shortcut, re-present the characteristic using a genuinely different matrix statistic or add a non-equivalent qualifying condition while retaining the shown example outputs.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats a valid triple as a triangle in the interference graph and tests common neighbors.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Z_{i,j}=0 for interference links, Z_{i,j}=1 otherwise, with trace(Z^5)=3.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses adjacency bitsets and neighbor intersections to find an interference triangle efficiently.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The matrix condition is determined solely by the three pairwise links among the selected transceivers.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Enumerates the eight possible off-diagonal patterns and reduces the condition to the all-interference case.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The statement explicitly defines all three off-diagonal entries as binary complements of the interference links.

common_affordance: The trace condition is mathematically equivalent to requiring the selected three transceivers to form a triangle of interference links.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates every 3-subset and computes the matrix statistic directly, giving cubic-time behavior and timing out for n up to 2000.

recommended_edit: Change the definition of the stability characteristic so it is not equivalent to triangle detection—for example, replace trace(Z^5) with a statistic involving an additional label-dependent or externally defined matrix component—while explicitly ensuring the two example outputs remain valid and guaranteeing a qualifying subset.
regression_risk: A sufficiently clear alternative statistic may allow glm-5 to derive another simple graph pattern; preserve the defeat by making the new condition depend on information not reducible to the three pairwise interference bits.
